s that are expensive to reverse, then the seven planes and their boundaries. (file: r1/SKILL.md)

hen planning a book, maintaining consistent voice across chapters, structuring a manuscript, or running an end-to-end pu

om competent to excellent. (file: r3/SKILL.md)

ructure, and complete directory organization. Use when you need to build custom skills for specific workflows, generate
